split_paragraphs_with_fuzzy_match: use Splitter.split to find the best paragraph and character split location using fuzzy string matching
split_using_first_and_last_words: use Splitter.split_first_last to refine page boundaries by comparing first and last words across pages
fuzzy_search_corpus_for_string: use Splitter.fuzzysearch to find a string in a corpus with special character normalization and fuzzy matching
evaluate_page_split_accuracy: use Splitter.evaluate_split to compute how well a predicted page split matches the actual page content
get_first_and_last_words: use get_first_last to extract the first and last N words from a delimited string
